name: Live Variable Link Model
short: Assigned variables keep tracking their source
description: The learner treats assignment as a permanent live link between variables.
prototypes: y changes whenever x changes after y = x
assignment permanently links two variables
قيمة y تتغير لاحقًا كلما تغيرت x

name: Simultaneous Execution Model
short: Program lines execute simultaneously
description: The learner ignores sequential execution and evaluates all lines from the final state.
prototypes: all assignment lines happen at the same time
use the final value of x for earlier lines
كل الأسطر تنفذ بنفس الوقت

name: Inclusive Stop Model
short: A loop always includes its stop value
description: The learner assumes the upper bound of a half-open range is executed.
prototypes: range one to four includes four
the stop value is another iteration
اللوب يشمل الرقم الأخير

name: Static Loop Condition Model
short: A loop condition is checked only once
description: The learner believes a loop condition is not re-evaluated after each iteration.
prototypes: the condition is checked only before the loop
a true loop condition never changes
يتم فحص الشرط مرة واحدة

name: Left-to-Right SQL Model
short: SQL AND/OR runs strictly left to right
description: The learner ignores SQL operator precedence.
prototypes: sql evaluates and and or from left to right
the first written operator always runs first
SQL ينفذ الشروط من اليسار إلى اليمين

name: Boolean Operator Conflation
short: AND and OR filter rows the same way
description: The learner treats AND and OR as interchangeable filters.
prototypes: and and or return the same rows
both operators just filter data
لا يوجد فرق بين AND و OR

name: Accuracy-Only AI Model
short: High accuracy proves an AI model is good
description: The learner evaluates a classifier using accuracy alone.
prototypes: a model with 99 percent accuracy must be excellent
accuracy alone proves the classifier works
إذا كانت accuracy عالية فالموديل ممتاز

name: Class Balance Blindness
short: Class imbalance cannot distort evaluation
description: The learner overlooks minority-class recall and imbalanced data.
prototypes: the number of examples in each class does not matter
minority recall is irrelevant when accuracy is high
عدم توازن الفئات لا يؤثر

name: Equal Reaction Model
short: Supports always share a load equally
description: The learner assumes support reactions are equal even for an off-center load.
prototypes: both supports carry half the load no matter where it is
support reactions are always equal
كل مسند يحمل نصف الحمل

name: Size Determines Force Model
short: The larger member always carries more force
description: The learner confuses member force with stress and cross-sectional area.
prototypes: the thicker member automatically receives more force
member size alone decides the load path
العضو الأكبر يحمل قوة أكبر دائمًا

name: Strength-Only Design Model
short: The strongest design is automatically best
description: The learner ignores cost, mass, usability, and other design constraints.
prototypes: choose the strongest design regardless of cost
engineering quality only means maximum strength
أفضل تصميم هو الأقوى فقط

name: Criteria-Constraint Conflation
short: Criteria and constraints mean the same thing
description: The learner does not distinguish desired performance from hard limits.
prototypes: criteria and constraints are identical
a preference and a hard limit are the same
المعايير والقيود شيء واحد

name: Local Change Model
short: Changing one component affects only that component
description: The learner ignores system-level interactions.
prototypes: changing one component cannot affect the full system
a local modification stays local
تغيير جزء لا يؤثر على باقي النظام

name: Perfect Redundancy Model
short: Adding a duplicate component doubles capacity
description: The learner assumes redundancy adds capacity linearly without load-sharing limits.
prototypes: a second component always doubles system capacity
redundancy means exactly twice the performance
إضافة جزء مماثل تضاعف القدرة دائمًا

name: Cheapest-Is-Optimal Model
short: The cheapest feasible design is always optimal
description: The learner reduces a multi-criteria decision to initial cost.
prototypes: the lowest price design is automatically optimal
cost is the only optimization objective
الحل الأرخص هو الحل الأمثل دائمًا

name: Single-Metric Optimization Model
short: Optimization means maximizing one metric
description: The learner ignores trade-offs between competing objectives.
prototypes: optimization means choose the maximum single value
the fastest design wins despite cost or reliability
التحسين يعني تعظيم مؤشر واحد فقط

name: Magic Sign Change Model
short: Terms change sign simply because they move
description: The learner uses the move-and-change-sign shortcut without preserving equality.
prototypes: a term changes sign because it crosses the equals sign
move it to the other side and flip it
ننقل الحد للطرف الآخر فتتغير الإشارة

name: Partial Distribution Model
short: A factor distributes to the first term only
description: The learner does not multiply every term inside parentheses.
prototypes: two times x plus three means two x plus three
the outside factor only multiplies the first term
العدد خارج القوس يضرب الحد الأول فقط

name: Repeated-Input Function Model
short: One input may have multiple outputs in a function
description: The learner allows the same function input to map to different outputs.
prototypes: a function can give two outputs for the same input
repeated input with different outputs is allowed
يمكن للمدخل نفسه أن يملك مخرجين في الدالة

name: Vertical-Line Direction Model
short: The vertical line test checks repeated y-values
description: The learner confuses repeated outputs with repeated inputs.
prototypes: repeated y values make a relation not a function
the vertical line test checks outputs
اختبار الخط العمودي يفحص تكرار المخرجات

name: Co-Increase Proportional Model
short: If both quantities increase, they are proportional
description: The learner identifies proportionality from direction rather than a constant ratio.
prototypes: two quantities are proportional because both increase
going up together proves proportionality
طالما القيمتان تزدادان فالعلاقة تناسبية

name: Additive Proportion Model
short: A constant difference proves proportionality
description: The learner confuses a constant additive change with a constant multiplicative ratio.
prototypes: a constant difference means the table is proportional
adding the same amount each row proves proportion
الفرق الثابت يعني تناسبًا طرديًا

name: Converse Equivalence Model
short: A conditional statement and its converse are equivalent
description: The learner assumes reversing if-then preserves truth.
prototypes: if p implies q then q must imply p
the converse is always equivalent
إذا صحت العبارة فالعكس صحيح دائمًا

name: Example-Proves-Rule Model
short: One confirming example proves a general rule
description: The learner treats a single example as a proof.
prototypes: one matching example proves the statement for all numbers
testing one value is a proof
مثال واحد ناجح يثبت القاعدة العامة
